Container.Name: immich-vectorchord-db-official
Container.Overview: Official Immich PostgreSQL 18 with VectorChord 0.5.3 and pgvector 0.8.1. This is the official database image from the Immich team with a built-in optimized PostgreSQL configuration (512MB shared_buffers, SSD/HDD auto-tuning, WAL compression). No manual tuning via Post Arguments needed. SSD vs HDD: Set the DB_STORAGE_TYPE variable to HDD if your database is not on an SSD. Defaults to SSD. VectorChord is the successor to pgvecto.rs and uses RaBitQ compression for efficient vector search. Immich uses these extensions for face recognition (face_index) and CLIP-based image search (clip_index). Watch the Immich base-images repo for updates: Version matrix: https://github.com/immich-app/base-images/blob/main/postgres/versions.yaml SSD config: https://github.com/immich-app/base-images/blob/main/postgres/postgresql.ssd.conf HDD config: https://github.com/immich-app/base-images/blob/main/postgres/postgresql.hdd.conf
Container.Requires: Database files must reside on locally attached storage (SSD/NVMe), not on a remote-mounted filesystem (e.g. NFS/SMB from another machine). Used as the database backend for Immich. Full setup guide: https://rorar.github.io/immich-unraid-manual/

Config.Name: POSTGRES_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Database password – please change! Use only A-Za-z0-9, no special characters. Generate a secure one in the Unraid terminal: openssl rand -base64 32 | tr -dc A-Za-z0-9 | head -c 32

Config.Name: POSTGRES_INITDB_ARGS
Config.Description: Arguments for initdb. --data-checksums enables checksums for data integrity.

Config.Name: Path: DB Data
Config.Description: Persistent database data directory. PG 18+ stores data in a version-specific subdirectory (18/docker). Must be on locally attached storage (SSD/NVMe), not a remote filesystem.

Config.Name: --- Storage Tuning ---
Config.Description: Built-in PostgreSQL tuning. The official Immich image auto-configures based on storage type.

Config.Name: DB_STORAGE_TYPE
Config.Description: Storage type for I/O tuning. Set to HDD if your database is not on an SSD/NVMe. Adjusts effective_io_concurrency and random_page_cost automatically.
